text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that shopping's done, time to 
head back to the academy and get ready for 
training--

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Wah! This eyeshadow is so cute...! This 
light pink glitter will look totally 
perfect under the eyes!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, I did tease in my 
stream that I'd do a cosmetics review 
someday...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...And so, while I was filming the video, 
I completely lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it wasn't on purpose, they were 
instructed never to skip training again in 
the future.
